name: sol5-ownership-ratchet
goal: Reject duplicate registered IDs and canonical runtime imports of their own forwarding entries while preserving supported facades and type-only references

evidence: Reject duplicate active IDs with disjoint sources and runtime imports of a reviewed owner through its own forwarding entry; keep supported forwards and type-only references.
The standard owned-file matrix checked source grouping and forwarded props, but omitted duplicate IDs and canonical backedges through the registryErrors public entry. Strengthen that existing matrix.
